summary: Creates DATABASES_REGISTRY, a mountainash_settings.profiles.Registry typed to BackendSpec and BackendProfile, and exposes the register decorator plus get_descriptor(name) and get_settings_class(name). REGISTRY is a read-only Mapping view over registered specs kept for backwards compatibility. _snapshot_for_tests and _reset_for_tests are test seams for registry isolation.
extension_points: @register on a BackendProfile subclass whose __spec__ is a BackendSpec adds a backend to the registry.
lifecycle_notes: REGISTRY is read-only; mutations go through @register.
core.factories iterates REGISTRY to map an Ibis dialect to a provider type.
documentation_hooks: How a backend becomes discoverable: @register → DATABASES_REGISTRY → get_settings_class/get_descriptor
risks: _reset_for_tests calls a private Registry method from mountainash_settings; it couples to that package's internals.
